title: Baby's First Learning 123
developmental_focus: Number recognition (1-10) paired with one-to-one counting practice. Ages 2-3 can reliably subitize quantities up to ~3 and are beginning rote counting; pairing each numeral with a clearly separated, countable set of the same object supports the transition to true one-to-one correspondence.
safety_notes: One number and one matching countable object set per page, numbers 1-10 only.
Objects on the right panel must be spaced clearly apart (not clustered/overlapping) so a caregiver can point to each one while counting aloud with the child.
Consistent googly-eyes-and-smile character treatment applied to every numeral and every object set across all 10 pages.
No small choking-hazard-shaped items depicted at graspable scale; all objects illustrated as whole clear scene elements (fruit, balloons, animals, stars).
